We need to determine number of methyl groups in the sample's molecule. We have no description of molecule. We can get NMR spectra to infer. Use proton NMR to see methyl signals (singlet ~0.9 ppm). Could also use carbon NMR for methyl carbons (~10-30 ppm). We need to measure spectra. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool (expensive). But maybe we can retrieve typical shifts? No, we need actual sample data. So we must call proton_nmr_spectra to get spectrum. Then count distinct methyl signals. However overlapping may be ambiguous. Could also use carbon NMR to count methyl carbons. Use carbon_nmr_spectra. That may be more direct: count signals in 10-30 ppm region. Use carbon NMR.

Let's call carbon_nmr_spectra.
